comment: The draft includes operational learning, AI evaluation and continuing stewardship, but the monitoring requirements are dispersed. Safety, bias and representational quality can degrade after deployment through data drift, model drift, workflow change, terminology updates, local adaptation and unintended use.

public.text: The draft includes operational learning, AI evaluation and continuing stewardship, but the monitoring requirements are dispersed. Safety, bias and representational quality can degrade after deployment through data drift, model drift, workflow change, terminology updates, local adaptation and unintended use.
public.suggestedRevision: Define a continuous learning-and-monitoring capability across safety-critical DPI-H components, not only AI, post-deployment performance and bias surveillance, data/model drift detection, incident reporting, clinician and patient feedback, outcome monitoring, version control, change impact assessment, regression testing and governed system improvement. Learning should improve implementation without weakening the protected identity, provenance, semantic, authorisation and accountability requirements.
